name: Sage Pack
author: IdentityOS
description: Turns an identity into a knowledge oracle. Current time in any timezone, instant calculations, web research, and text analysis — all synced to factual real-world data. The identity is never disconnected from reality.

capabilities.reason: Real-time clock, timezone conversion, date arithmetic
Instant computation, unit conversion, what-if calculations
Live web fetching, content extraction, online research

example_uses: What time is it in Berlin right now?
Look up the latest news about Python 3.14
Fetch the Wikipedia page for quantum computing and summarize it
